briefs.title: Factual Entertainment and Factual brief
briefs.summary: Prime-time ITV1 9pm only (no pre-watershed). Premium, optimistic, big-hearted, broad appeal. Fact ent: ensemble talent, competition/constructed formats, event programming, authored ITVX shows with talent. Factual (ITVX): feature docs and doc boxsets with directorial flair; crime boxsets, anthologies, feature docs incl. cons and swindles; event and anniversary pieces. Wants exclusive access, surprising talent, witty titles. Avoid blues-and-twos, old-fashioned features, singing competitions, overly dark or dumbed-down ideas.
briefs.date: 2025-11-19 (page shows 'Wednesday 19 November' with no year; 19 Nov fell on a Wednesday in 2025)

briefs.title: Current Affairs brief
briefs.summary: Stories reflecting ITV's audience on social, political and economic issues; strong people-led narratives; access only where it drives narrative; mostly UK. Tonight: a few indie half-hours (core supply from ITV Studios/ITV News). Exposure: about seven investigative one-hour one-offs a year. Also 9pm singles or short (possibly two-part) series tied to events, exclusive interviews or reactive pieces.
briefs.date: 2025-02-25 (page shows 'Tuesday 25 February' with no year; inferred 2025 from weekday)

briefs.title: Entertainment & Reality brief - Authored Documentary
briefs.summary: Small number of authored documentaries with big talent telling new stories (example: Freddie Flintoff: Understanding Tourette's). Reality: fast-turnaround formats with a clear premise; no more dating or survival formats for now.
briefs.date: 2026-10-27 (page shows 'Tuesday 27 October' with no year; inferred 2026 from weekday)

briefs.title: ITV2 brief
briefs.summary: Factual must relate to younger audiences: true crime, wellbeing, celebrity. Fact ent expanded; returning series welcome, e.g. reality-familiar talent through life events, nightly location-based formats. Studio-based closed episodic formats less desirable.
briefs.date: 2025-08-27 (page shows 'Wednesday 27 August' with no year; inferred 2025 from weekday)

briefs.title: Daytime brief
briefs.summary: Weekday afternoons (2-6pm): quiz and formats, limited slots, talent helps. Weekend mornings: lifestyle and cookery, limited slots. Weekday mornings not commissioning. No factual-specific section.
briefs.date: 2025-10-14 (page shows 'Tuesday 14 October' with no year; inferred 2025 from weekday)

briefs.title: Outlier - sports documentary strand (successor to Fresh Cuts)
briefs.summary: Six standalone 46-min sports docs, GBP 50,000 each, for ITV's Year of Sport 2026; funded by Diversity Commissioning Spend; pitches only from companies owned by People of Colour and/or Deaf, Disabled and Neurodivergent creatives. Applications closed 10 April 2026.
